requirement: Build scheduler.py with solve(value), plus a helper module. value is {data: tasks, options: {}}. Each task has id (string), status, priority (integer, default 0), dependencies (list of ids, default []). Return {order: [ids]} containing only queued or retry tasks whose every dependency exists and has status exactly tested. Queued and retry dependencies are NOT complete, even if they appear earlier in the output. Missing or failed dependencies block the task. Sort eligible tasks by descending priority, then ascending id. Never include running, tested, failed or cancelled tasks. Do not mutate input. Every dependency must have status exactly tested; queued or retry dependencies are incomplete even when otherwise available. Output exactly JSON shaped as {order: list_of_ids}. Place ALL source modules inside the files mapping; valid shape is {files: {scheduler.py: source, helpers.py: source}}. Never return a modules field.
title: Dependency-aware task scheduling
